overview: [Sample response] Your solution starts with tools and moves quickly to delivery; the AI's starts with people and data definitions and delays tooling. Yours gets results faster; the AI's is more likely to fix the underlying cause.
common_ground: Both aim for a single trusted set of leadership reports.
Both deliver in phases rather than all at once.

differences.yours: Selects a reporting tool in the first two weeks.
differences.ai: Interviews report users and agrees on metric definitions first.
differences.why_it_matters: Choosing a tool before agreeing on definitions risks rebuilding the same inconsistencies in a new place.

differences.ai: Names an owner for each metric.
differences.why_it_matters: Without owners, data quality tends to slip again after the project ends.

differences.yours: First dashboards in about six weeks.
differences.ai: No reports until the data store is built.
differences.why_it_matters: Early visible wins often matter for keeping sponsor support.

questions_to_consider: How much does the client need an early visible win?
Is anyone on the client side ready to own the data?
Could you do definitions and a quick-win report in parallel?
